details:
Y'know what'd be a few good additions to the game?

1. Flight (toggleable, with the host/creator of a world taking priority. This is helpful for getting around places faster in addition to helping moderators/hosts reach a troublesome user faster to warn or kick them.

2. no-clip: toggleable, with the host/creator of a world taking priority. Can help with moderation to get to a troublesome user more quickly and file a warning or kick. This can also be a roleplay ability for characters who are ghosts.

3. Vanish/Spectator: By making the user invisible,his is great for hosts and moderators to keep track of players and catch them in the act of harassment or rule-breaking. It's also helpful for those who want to witness a roleplay but can't participate in it. Practically the camera person in a sense, or your typical ghosts. (Possible way to nerf this to avoid harassment is by making a spectator mute while in spectator mode)

4. Resize: Turns out uploading models repeatedly in attempt to get the size just right can lead to being flagged or blocked for spam, so this is useful. This can negate that problem.

5. player highlight/Aura: to help find a friend or player or figure out where players are in an instance to ensure things aren't going awry such as a fight or some other issue. (This especially helps in moderating as a host to warn people who cause trouble on the other side of the map, but it can also be used as an ability in roleplay as well (like Lucario)).

All of these features can be toggled per user, but host can override to allow/disallow it either globally or individually, and the world owners can also override to have them allowed/disallowed. (preferably allowed by default if it's ever implemented.)
title: Optional flight/resize/aura/others?
